blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Mayor Nestor Archival confirmed Wednesday that City Administrator Albert Tan has resigned, paving the way for City Attorney Briccio Joseph Boholst to formally take over the post next week. Archival told CDN Digital that Tan submitted his resignation on Tuesday and that he had already forwarded the letter to the city’s Human Resources Development Office. “Yes, that’s correct,” Archival said when asked to confirm Tan’s resignation.
